**2208 Ekkocardiografi** is a specific medical procedure code registered in the [[sygesikringsregisteret|Sygesikringsregisteret]] (the Danish Health Insurance Register) [^src1]. It is utilized within the Danish healthcare system to identify and track [[ekkokardiografi|echocardiography]] examinations, specifically serving as a critical data point for the national quality measurement and monitoring of atrial fibrillation (atrieflimren) care [^src1]. 

As part of the clinical quality indicators managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute, this code helps calculate denominators, numerators, and exclusion criteria for atrial fibrillation treatment and diagnostics [^src2]. The Sygesikringsregisteret contains a specific set of codes for echocardiography to ensure standardized data collection and comparison across regions. Alongside 2208, the register includes codes such as [[3810-ekkocardiografi-standardundersoegelse|3810 Ekkocardiografi, standardundersøgelse]], [[3811-ekkocardiografi-avanceret-undersoegelse|3811 Ekkocardiografi, avanceret undersøgelse]], [[5101-ekko-cardiografi|5101 EKKO-cardiografi]], [[5102-transsofageal-ekko|5102 Transsøfofagal ekko.]], [[5103-stress-ekkocardiogra|5103 Stress ekkocardiogra]], [[6402-ekkocardiografi|6402 Ekkocardiografi]], [[6408-ekkocardiografi|6408 Ekkocardiografi]], and [[0906-ekko-kardiografi|0906 Ekko-kardiografi]] [^src1]. 

Through these standardized codes, health authorities can systematically evaluate the quality of diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up for both incident and prevalent patient populations with cardiovascular diseases, ensuring evidence-based clinical standards are implemented nationwide [^src3].
